## 0.2.0 design system

Runtime API 3. A design system for productivity tools, separated from a neutral
runtime. The specification is in `docs/design/` (principles, atoms, composition,
themes, wireframes, decisions D1-D60); `docs/releases/0.2.0.md` has the
migration notes. Crate versions are still 0.1.8: the version bump and the
release follow separately.

51 commits, 398 files (+26,484 / -7,477).

### What changes

- **Neutral runtime and token base.** Themes are an open token registry;
  components declare the tokens and environment values they read and
  preparation validates them. The design language lives in
  `registry/tokens.rhai`; palettes carry colors only.
- **62 components rebuilt** on one set of contracts (size and density axes, one
  content inset, a 2px ink focus frame, four marker silhouettes, one tab stop
  per control).
- **Layouts and patterns**: Stack, Inline, Toolbar (with a `fill` slot), Region
  (`scroll`, `external_title`); Section, DescriptionList, Stat, FormLayout,
  InlineState, DataView, ListDetail, AppShell with F6 regions.
- **Composition audit and profiles** (`composition_audit`, `gpui-rhai init
  --profile productivity`, `check` literal-geometry warnings).
- **The Gallery is a Rhai application** on AppShell: 83 pages, four keyboard
  scenes, a live audit count, a theme picker, square / subtle / round corners,
  and on macOS its own TitleBar in place of the platform one.
- **Runtime additions in this round**: `.signal_style(signal, #{ state: style() })`;
  `InvocationContext` for capability calls; `ctx.virtual_item_bounds`; Table
  `on_context_request`; Table column `typography`; span `typography` and
  `background`; decorative grips for SplitPane and Resizable.

### Review and issues resolved here

Review R1-R5 (threads answered): stretch fast path only where it is the same
box (R1), hot reload validated as a candidate and committed atomically (R2),
Table keyboard for NativeCollection data (R3), one key-matching rule for all
phases (R4), incomplete `by_env` tables rejected (R5). The review probes pass.

- Fixes #83: decorative grips for SplitPane (`handle`) and Resizable (`grips`), painted above the panes, overhang starts the drag; `line`, `line_inset`; general `.signal_style`.
- Fixes #89: Table `on_context_request` (right press selects first; Shift+F10 and the menu key).
- Fixes #91: `CapabilityHandler::call_with(&InvocationContext, ..)` with the call's origin, view and component.
- Fixes #95: Table column `typography: "code"`, span `typography`/`background`; the mono face is the token base's `code` role.
- Fixes #109: overlay and Layer identity is (declaring instance, key); `parent_overlay` resolves through the render ancestry; `overlay_placement` reports ambiguity, `overlay_placement_in` names the instance; shared layout groups per instance.
- Fixes #110: components in a virtual item are named by the item (`Item[<key>]`).
- Fixes #112: the audit covers error boundaries, Layer content and realized virtual rows.
- Fixes #113: a pushed sticky header is clipped to the list.
- Fixes #114: three audit false positives.
- Fixes #115: Toolbar `fill`; DataView passes `fill`, `size`, `inset`.
- Fixes #116: caller-written shortcuts show platform legends.
- Fixes #117: migration gaps in the release notes; Region `scroll`.
- Fixes #118: Table group headers in the label voice; one 2px focus frame for containers that hold focus; AppShell's scope documented.

### Breaking changes

Listed in `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/releases/0.2.0.md`. Added in this round:
components in virtual items gain an `Item[<key>]` path segment (state resets
once); overlay identity per instance, `overlay_placement` returns a `Result`,
`OverlayNodeSpec`/`LayerNodeSpec` gain `owner`; `AsyncDelivery` gains
`origin`; `VirtualCollectionNodeSpec` gains `inherited_motion_scope`;
incomplete `by_env` tables are rejected; failures stay reported until
acknowledged.

### Verification (local, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, at `a1fd370`)

- `cargo fmt --check` in the workspace, `tests/native-keyboard` and `tests/performance`: exit 0.
- Clippy `--all-targets -D warnings` in the same three (workspace `--all-features`, native with `dev-reload`): exit 0.
- `cargo test --workspace --all-features --all-targets`: 679 passed, 0 failed on Rust 1.95 (MSRV) and on 1.97.1.
- `tests/native-keyboard`: 269 passed, 0 failed (45 targets); `token_reload` with `dev-reload`: 3 passed.
- `tests/performance` (release): 2 passed. Review probes: 5 passed.
- `scripts/release-smoke.sh`: 28 smoke cases passed, exit 0.
- Frame budget (release `gallery_profile`): `Window::draw` p95 at most 3.38 ms across all interactions (gate 8.3 ms).
- Visuals, compared in RGB with a known-different positive control: the 19 Gallery and 38 example baselines match the committed PNGs; all 83 Gallery pages in both densities were captured against the pre-batch head, and only the pages that gained a section changed (Toolbar, Region, Table, Typography, SplitPane). Two baselines were recaptured on purpose (Table zh-CN, the form showcase Dialog with its focus frame).
- Real windows, CGEvent: `docs/audits/2026-10-07-0.2.0-candidate/real-window.md` (title bar drag, double press and control presses; Tab focus; command palette; clipboard; multi-window stores, close request and per-window theme; Table context menu). One finding, fixed in `3b30144` with a regression test: a panel that took focus during layout did not redraw its focus frame.

After that run, `48cdd0b` fixes PanZoom and Rotatable jumping back to the start of a drag on release until another input redrew (reported by the maintainer; Draggable and SplitPane were checked and not affected). At `48cdd0b`: workspace 679 passed, `tests/native-keyboard` 271 passed, both Clippy runs exit 0, the 19 + 38 baselines unchanged, and the real-window re-check is in the same record.

Then `5137b58` gives fields their own side padding (D61): `metrics.field_pad`, about 1.4 times the gap between the frame and the text (comfortable 5 / 7 / 10 / 12, compact 3 / 4 / 6 / 10), so md field text starts on `metrics.inset` like row text; Textarea's vertical padding follows the same ratio; Button, Tabs and ToggleGroup keep `metrics.control_pad`. At `5137b58`: workspace 680 passed on 1.95 and on 1.97.1, `tests/native-keyboard` 271, `token_reload` 3, fmt and Clippy (1.95) exit 0, `gallery_profile` draw p95 at most 3.98 ms. The 19 Gallery and 24 of the 38 example baselines were recaptured on purpose (Dashboard unchanged). Of the 83 pages in each density, every page changes only in the title bar's two Selects except 16 that hold fields (Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, DatePicker, InputGroup, FormField, FormLayout, Toolbar, Inline, DataView, Command, the density and spacing foundations, the form and operations scenes).

Second review round (S1–S4, review at `48cdd0b`), each with a regression test that fails without its fix: `bd612d3` Region's non-scrolling body clips (S4, #117); `af53c17` signal-selected styles and signal sizes are merged before the stretch rules (S3); `11dc087` queued actions and component events keep the origin they were queued under (S2, #91; `ActionInvocation` and `PendingEvent` gain `origin`); `2c5e8a0` grips take presses only where they are visible and not covered, through a hitbox recorded by nodes with an element ref (S1, #83). At `2c5e8a0`: the review's runner passes the previous 5 and the new 5 probes; workspace 680 passed on 1.95 and on 1.97.1; `tests/native-keyboard` 275; `token_reload` 3; fmt and Clippy (1.95) exit 0; `gallery_profile` draw p95 at most 2.94 ms; the 19 + 38 baselines and all 83 pages in both densities are pixel-identical (RGB) to `5137b58`, with a known-different pair as the positive control.

Correction: earlier "pixel-identical" statements in this PR were made with Pillow's `getbbox()` on RGBA differences, which only looks at alpha. Everything above was re-checked in RGB; the earlier claim that 415 full-page renders were identical after the performance work could not be re-verified and is withdrawn.

### Known gaps

- IME preedit and VoiceOver are left to the maintainer.
- An Input keeps its selection highlighted after focus moves to another field.
- The macOS window buttons sit about 1pt low in compact density; window drag areas are not handled on Windows.
- On Linux a span's `code` role uses the role's first family only; whether it falls back to DejaVu Sans Mono there is unverified.

title: 0.2.0 design system: neutral runtime, token base, rebuilt components and the acceptance Gallery
